note: Alchemy (2009) — 12 kingdom cards. Cards with Potion in their cost require a Potion to buy. Vineyard is a separate 12-card pile; everything else is 10.

cards.name: Alchemist
cards.text: +2 Cards; +1 Action. At the start of Clean-up, if you have a Potion in play, you may put this on top of your deck.

cards.name: Apothecary
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action. Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Put the Coppers and Potions into your hand, and put the rest back on top in any order.

cards.name: Apprentice
cards.text: +1 Action. Trash a card from your hand. +1 Card per $1 it costs. +2 Cards if it has Potion in its cost.

cards.name: Familiar
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action. Each other player gains a Curse.

cards.name: Golem
cards.text: Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal two Action cards that aren't Golem. Play them in either order (they don't count as Action plays). Discard the other revealed cards.

cards.name: Herbalist
cards.text: +1 Buy; +$1. At the start of Clean-up, you may put a Treasure from play on top of your deck.

cards.name: Philosopher's Stone
cards.text: When you play this, +$1 per 5 cards in your deck and discard pile, rounded down.

cards.name: Possession
cards.text: You may look at the player to your right's hand, deck, and discard. They take their next turn after you. That turn, you make their decisions for them.

cards.name: Scrying Pool
cards.text: +1 Action. Each player (including you) reveals the top card of their deck, and you choose whether they discard it or put it back. Then reveal cards from your deck until you reveal an Action card. Put all revealed non-Action cards into your hand and discard the Action.

cards.name: Transmute
cards.text: Trash a card from your hand. If it's an Action card, gain a Duchy. If it's a Treasure card, gain a Transmute. If it's a Victory card, gain a Gold.

cards.name: University
cards.text: +2 Actions. You may gain an Action card costing up to $5.

cards.name: Vineyard
cards.text: Worth 1 VP per 3 Action cards in your deck (rounded down).
